# TechInsurance

> > TechInsurance provides specialized business insurance coverage for technology companies, IT professionals, and small businesses, including professional liability, cyber insurance, and general liability policies.

TechInsurance offers online insurance quotes and policies tailored to tech businesses and IT companies, with coverage options including errors and omissions (E&O), cyber liability, workers' compensation, and business owners policies (BOP). The platform serves consultants, software developers, healthcare IT, and other technology professionals with ACORD-compliant commercial insurance solutions.

## Key Topics

- Professional liability insurance (E&O)
- Cyber insurance and data breach coverage
- General liability insurance
- Workers' compensation
- Business owners policy (BOP)
- Small business insurance
- Technology business insurance
- IT company coverage
- Errors and omissions protection
- Commercial insurance quotes
- Liability protection for tech professionals
- Insurance cost for small businesses
- ACORD forms and standards
